verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not an AI agent or software application that could act as an MCP client. Plugging MCP servers in so it can use their tools is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows any agentic or MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
